description: Navigate code through the project's language server. Servers: pyright, tsserver, rust-analyzer, clangd (local git checkouts). Answers by meaning, not text: no hits from comments, strings or same-named symbols. definition / references / hover: give path and symbol (the identifier), plus the 1-based line it is on (omit line to use the symbol's declaration in the file, else the first occurrence the server resolves). symbols: with query, find a name across the workspace (path = any source file of that language in the project); without query, an outline of path. Returns path:line:col plus the source line, at most 50 results.
name: lsp

column.description: 1-based column; only when symbol is ambiguous on its line.

path.description: Source file to query (absolute, or relative to the working directory).

query.description: symbols: name or prefix to search the workspace for.

symbol.description: The identifier to look up (definition / references / hover).
